title: Headless Back in Your Own Backyard (VNelson): Ranger Milo at the NCR checkpoint asks the player to free the three NCR hostages the Legion holds at Nelson (stage 100)

actions.text: Path: at the ranger checkpoint above Nelson Ranger Milo, told the player is no friend of the Legion (Speech 25, given), tells of the hostages and asks the player to free them (stage 10); the three are cut loose (each one's message box, button 1: NumHostages, objective 15); Milo pays (100: NCR fame, Legion infamy, 50 caps). The Legion's side is the hostages killed (HostagesKilled 3, Milo's Topic024); fail: Milo dead (20).
Stand-in for the trip to the ranger checkpoint.

Near Nelson the Legion explorers each stop the player once (two here) when his script first runs (nvNelsonExplorerBarkSCRIPT: StartConversation while We Are Legion has not started); the player walks off from each.

actions.label: no friend of the legion (Speech 25; follow-up: his Topic006 line)

actions.text: Stand-in for the sneak into Nelson: each hostage is cut loose (his message box, button 1).
Stand-in for the trip back to the checkpoint.
In Nelson more explorers stopped the player; the player walks off from each.
Stage 10 sent Milo running down to his post (MiloTalk 4: 'let it wait until I've stopped running'); stand-in for his arrival: the run package's done event, whose end script sets MiloTalk 5.
At his post Milo first says his one goodbye greeting (covering the player from the ridge); talked to again he asks for news.
